43900.grammar: pr, pass of parimuñcati, intrans (+abl or +instr)
43900.meaning1: is completely freed; is totally liberated; escapes (from)
43900.commentary: (SNa) verā na parimuccatī'ti ahaṃ satimā'ti ettakena verato na muccati.

examples.text: paradukkh'ūpadhānena, attano sukham'icchati. verasaṃsaggasaṃsaṭṭho, verā so na parimuccati.
diṭṭhi-saṃyojana-saṃyutto, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano na parimuccati jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi, na parimuccati dukkhasmā'ti vadāmi

yaṃnūna mayaṃ catutthe migajāte ajjhupekkheyyāmā'ti. ajjhupekkhiṃsu kho, bhikkhave, nevāpiko ca nevāpikaparisā ca catutthe migajāte. evañ'hi te, bhikkhave, catutthā migajātā parimucciṃsu nevāpikassa iddh'ānubhāvā.

tatra, bhikkhave, nevāpikassa ca nevāpikaparisāya ca etadahosi, sace kho mayaṃ catutthe migajāte ghaṭṭessāma, te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti te ghaṭṭitā aññe ghaṭṭissanti. evaṃ imaṃ nivāpaṃ nivuttaṃ sabbaso migajātā parimuñcissanti.

43905.meaning1: completely confused; totally muddled-minded; (comm) who have forgotten mindfulness

examples.text: parimuṭṭhā paṇḍit'ābhāsā, vācāgocarabhāṇino, yāv'icchanti mukh'āyāmaṃ, yena nītā na taṃ vidū.
ahañ'ca kho namassantī, sambuddhaṃ puris'uttamaṃ, parimuttā sabbadukkhehi, satthusāsanakārikā'ti.

43908.meaningLit: causing to be free all around

43909.meaningLit: caused to be free all around

43910.meaning1: sets free; releases; liberates; lets out (from)
43910.synonym: ussajjati, osajjati, ossajjati, pamuñcati, pamocayati, mocayati, moceti, vimoceti

examples.text: sā kaṇhaṃ nāma janesi. jāto kaṇho pabyāhāsi, dhovatha maṃ, amma, nahāpetha maṃ amma, imasmā maṃ asucismā parimocetha, atthāya vo bhavissāmī'ti.
anāpatti, imesaṃ sutvā oramissāmi viramissāmi vūpasamissāmi attānaṃ parimocessāmī'ti gacchati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

43911.meaningLit: having caused to be free all around

43912.meaningLit: causing to be free all around

43913.meaningLit: caused to be free all around

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva k'āyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ye te lābhā dhammikā dhammaladdhā antamaso pattapariyāpannamattam'pi tathārūpehi lābhehi appaṭivibhattabhogī hoti sīlavantehi sabrahmacārīhi sādhāraṇabhogī, ayam'pi dhammo sāraṇīyo.

43915.grammar: masc, in comps, abbrev of pariyāya

examples.text: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhu, bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti.
bahunā'pi kho taṃ vibhajeyyaṃ, pariyāyena tādiso dhammo, saṃkhittam'atthaṃ lapayissāmi, yāvatā me manasā pariyattaṃ.

43917.commentary: (PYt) na pariyattan'ti na samatthaṃ. iminā n'ālan'ti ettha alaṃsaddo pariyatt'attho'va, n'āraha-bhūsana-vāraṇ'attho'ti dasseti.

examples.text: tattha alan'ti hotu, pariyattan'ti attho. kiṃnu me'ti kiṃ mayhaṃ kiccaṃ, kiṃ karaṇīyaṃ, kiṃ sādhetabban'ti attho.
so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.

43923.meaning1: who is devoted to learning; who studies scriptures a lot

examples.text: so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
iti kho, bhikkhu, desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.
parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ uddhaṃ pādatalā adho kesamatthakā tacapariyantaṃ pūraṃ nānappakārassa asucino paccavekkhati
dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, māyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.
accayāsi, brāhmaṇa, pañhaṃ, n'āsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṃ gahetuṃ. nibbān'ogadhañ'hi, brāhmaṇa, brahmacariyaṃ vussati nibbānaparāyaṇaṃ nibbānapariyosānan'ti.

tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajjitabbo, yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo, ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
tato ce uttari sādiyeyyā'ti atthi pavāraṇā bhesajjapariyantā na rattipariyantā, atthi pavāraṇā rattipariyantā na bhesajjapariyantā
manāpapariyantaṃ khv'āhaṃ, mahārāja, pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aggan'ti vadāmi. t'eva, mahārāja, rūpā ekaccassa manāpā honti, t'eva rūpā ekaccassa amanāpā honti.
doṇamite sukhadukkhe pariyantakate saṃsāre, n'atthi hāyanavaḍḍhane, n'atthi ukkaṃs'āvakaṃse.

43932.meaning1: who is limited; who is restricted (in)
43932.commentary: (ANt) pariyantakārī'ti sapariyantaṃ katvā vattā. pariyantavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā'ti (dī. ni. 1.9, 194) hi vuttaṃ.

examples.text: etha tumhe, āvuso, appabhassā hotha, bhasse pariyantakārino'ti, iti bhassapariyante samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā.

43933.meaning1: wandering around the periphery; roaming around the edges

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma gokāṇā pariyantacārinī antam'antān'eva sevati. evam'eva suññ'āgārahatā samaṇassa gotamassa paññā, aparis'āvacaro samaṇo gotamo, n'ālaṃ sallāpāya.

43934.meaning1: seeing the end; understanding the limit

examples.text: sabbe sattā āhāraṭṭhitikā, imasmiṃ kho, bhikkhave, ekadhamme bhikkhu sammā nibbindamāno sammā virajjamāno sammā vimuccamāno sammā pariyantadassāvī samma'd'atthaṃ abhisamecca diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti.

43935.grammar: aor of pariyantaṃ karoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, māyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.

43936.meaning1: restricted; within limits; with defined purpose
43936.commentary: (MNa) pariyantavatin'ti paricchedaṃ dassetvā yathāssā paricchedo paññāyati, evaṃ bhāsatī'ti attho.

examples.text: kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ

43937.meaning1: limited to; bounded by; circumscribed by
43937.commentary: (MNa) kāyapariyantikan'ti kāyakoṭikaṃ. yāva kāyapavattā uppajjitvā tato paraṃ anuppajjanavedanan'ti attho. (SNa) kāyapariyantikan'ti kāyaparicchinnaṃ, yāva pañcadvārakāyo pavattati, tāva pavattaṃ pañcadvārikavedanan'ti attho.

examples.text: so kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti, jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī'ti pajānāti

43938.meaning1: with a terrace around the house; with a surrounding verandah
43938.commentary: (VINa) samantā pariyāgāro'ti samantā pan'assa maṇḍalamāḷaparikkhepo hoti. so kira majjhe caturassaṃ gabbhaṃ katvā bahi maṇḍalamāḷaparikkhepena kato, yathā sakkā hoti anto'y'eva āviñchantehi vicarituṃ.

examples.text: tass'āyasmato vihāro abhirūpo hoti dassanīyo pāsādiko, majjhegabbho, samantāpariyāgāro, supaññattaṃ mañcapīṭhaṃ bhisibimbohanaṃ, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ supaṭṭhitaṃ, pariveṇaṃ susammaṭṭhaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhu, telañ'ca paṭicca vaṭṭiñ'ca paṭicca telappadīpo jhāyati, tass'eva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā aññassa ca anupahārā anāhāro nibbāyati.
thāmavā hoti yāva jīvitamaraṇapariyādānā thāmaṃ upadaṃsetā.
tassa rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.

43944.grammar: abs of caus of pari √ādā, caus, trans (+acc)
43944.meaning1: having become obsessed; having become fixated; having grasped excessively
43944.meaningLit: having caused to take all around

examples.text: yadetaṃ, mahārāja, tathāgato na bhaṇeyya, pattacīvaram'pi attano pariyādāpetvā bhikkhū buddhapūjaṃ y'eva kareyyun'ti. sādhu, bhante nāgasena, evam'etaṃ tathā sampaṭicchāmī'ti.
tassa kho esā, aggivessana, uppannā'pi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannā'pi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa.
tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma, na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.

43947.meaning2: having taken up in a excessive degree

examples.text: tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissāma, na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatī'ti.
pathavīsamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. pathavīsamañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāp'āmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
atha kho tesaṃ, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ jāyam'patikānaṃ evam'assa, amhākaṃ kho yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhīṇā pariyādiṇṇā
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati.

43950.meaning2: exhausted, taken up in a excessive degree

examples.text: atha kho tesaṃ, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ jāyam'patikānaṃ evam'assa, amhākaṃ kho yā parittā sambalamattā sā parikkhīṇā pariyādinnā

43951.meaning1: overwhelmed; overpowered; under the control of

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco yena dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati
yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco yena dukkhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto socati kilamati paridevati, urattāḷiṃ kandati, sammohaṃ āpajjati
yadapi luddho lobhena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto parassa asatā dukkhaṃ uppādayati.

43953.meaning1: who has exhausted the cycle of existence
43953.meaning2: who has finished the cycle of existence

examples.text: yatra hi nāma tathāgato atīte buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinnavaṭume pariyādinnavaṭṭe sabbadukkhavītivatte jātito'pi anussarissati, nāmato'pi anussarissati

43954.meaning2: is overpowered, is become exhausted, is controlled
43954.synonym: ajjhottharati, addhabhāveti, parisahati, pasahati, bhunāti, sahati
43954.commentary: (ANa) n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyantī'ti etassa khīṇ'āsavassa cittaṃ gahetvā ṭhātuṃ na sakkonti.

examples.text: evaṃ sammā vimuttacittassa, bhante, bhikkhuno bhusā ce'pi cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā cakkhussa āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, n'ev'assa cittaṃ pariyādiyanti.

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, aniccasaññā bhāvitā bahulīkatā sabbaṃ kāmarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ rūparāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ bhavarāgaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ avijjaṃ pariyādiyati sabbaṃ asmimānaṃ samūhanati.

atha kho tesaṃ satthavāhānaṃ etadahosi, ayaṃ kho mahāsakaṭasattho sakaṭasahassaṃ, te mayaṃ yena yena gacchāma, khippam'eva pariyādiyati tiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ haritakapaṇṇaṃ. yaṃnūna mayaṃ imaṃ satthaṃ dvidhā vibhajeyyāma, ekato pañca sakaṭasatāni ekato pañca sakaṭasatānī'ti.

43956.meaning2: was overpowered, was become exhausted, was controlled

examples.text: kulaputto taṃ sutvā arūp'āvacarajjhāne nikantiṃ pariyādiyi, bhagavā tassa rūp'āvacar'ārūp'āvacaresu nikantiyā pariyādinnabhāvaṃ ñatvā arahattanikūṭaṃ gaṇhanto so n'eva taṃ abhisaṅkharotī'ti-ādim'āha.
nāgo kujjhitvā konām'āyaṃ muṇḍako mayhaṃ vasanaṭṭhānaṃ pavisitvā nisinno'ti dhūpāyi, thero uttaritaraṃ dhūpāyi. nāgo, pajjali, thero'pi uttaritaraṃ pajjalitvā tassa tejaṃ pariyādiyi.

43957.meaning1: having overcome; having overpowered; having overwhelmed

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ rañño māgadhassa ajātasattuno vedehiputtassa sabbaṃ hatthikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ assakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ rathakāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā sabbaṃ pattikāyaṃ pariyādiyitvā jīvantam'eva naṃ osajjeyyan'ti.
āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti… poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya
bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
yo pana bhikkhu anvaddhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, idān'eva kho ahaṃ jānāmi, ayam'pi kira dhammo sutt'āgato suttapariyāpanno anvaddhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatī'ti.

43961.commentary: (DNa) ettha pariyāpannā'ti ettha mayhaṃ desanājāle pariyāpannā, etena ābaddhā antojālīkatā ca hutvā ummujjamānā ummujjanti, na h'ettha asaṅgahito diṭṭhigatiko nāma atthī'ti.

examples.text: sabbe te imeh'eva dvāsaṭṭhiyā vatthūhi antojālīkatā, ettha sitā'va ummujjamānā ummujjanti, ettha pariyāpannā antojālīkatā'va ummujjamānā ummujjanti.
yo so yodh'ājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tam'enaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī'ti.

43963.commentary: (NIDD1a) yaṃ tassa pariyāpuṭan'ti tena puggalena yaṃ pariyāpuṭaṃ sajjhāyitaṃ karaṇ'atthe sāmivacanaṃ. pariyāpuṭṭan'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: tassā'pi naravīrassa, pabbajitvāna sāsane, pariyāpuṭasaddhammā, paripucchāvisāradā.
katamaṃ pariyattisāsanaṃ? yaṃ tassa pariyāpuṭaṃ, suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ, idaṃ pariyattisāsanaṃ.

43965.meaning2: you must master by yourself; let you learn by yourself

examples.text: iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavan'ti vattāro.
tassa bhavanti vattāro, iṅgha tāva āyasmā āgamaṃ pariyāpuṇassū'ti, iti'ssa bhavanti vattāro.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacce moghapurisā dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, suttaṃ, geyyaṃ, veyyākaraṇaṃ, gāthaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, jātakaṃ, abbhutadhammaṃ, vedallaṃ.
so kho ahaṃ, aggivessana, nacirass'eva khippam'eva taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇiṃ.

43968.meaning1: should be mastered; should be studied; should be thoroughly learned

examples.text: tesu bhaññamānesu na sussūsissanti na sotaṃ odahissanti na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpessanti na ca te dhamme uggahetabbaṃ pariyāpuṇitabbaṃ maññissanti.

43969.meaning1: having mastered; having studied; having thoroughly learned

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ, tāta sudassana, bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā mama bhatt'ābhihāre bhāsa. ahañ'ca te devasikaṃ kahāpaṇasataṃ bhikkhaṃ pavattayissāmī'ti.
te taṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇitvā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ paññāya atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti. tesaṃ te dhammā paññāya atthaṃ anupaparikkhataṃ na nijjhānaṃ khamanti.

43970.commentary: (DNa) samattā pariyāputā'ti padabyañjanāni ahāpetvā paripuṇṇaṃ uggahitā. attham'pi pāḷim'pi visaṃvādetvā sabbaso vā pana appaguṇaṃ katvā bhaṇantassa hi parittaṃ tejavantaṃ na hoti, sabbaso paguṇaṃ katvā bhaṇantass'eva tejavantaṃ hoti. lābhahetu uggahetvā bhaṇantassāpi atthaṃ na sādheti, nissaraṇapakkhe ṭhatvā mettaṃ purecārikaṃ katvā bhaṇantass'eva atthāya hotī'ti dasseti.

examples.text: yassa kassaci, mārisa, bhikkhussa vā bhikkhuniyā vā upāsakassa vā upāsikāya vā ayaṃ āṭānāṭiyā rakkhā suggahitā bhavissati samattā pariyāputā.

43971.synonym: ākāra, upakkama, upāya, ñāya, niyāma, nīhāra, pakāra, patha, magga, vidhi

examples.text: siyā pan'āvuso añño'pi pariyāyo yathā ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti
evam'eva kho, bhante, cetaso bhikkhu dabbajātiko, yato yato imassa dhammapariyāyassa paññāya atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, labheth'eva attamanataṃ, labheth'eva cetaso pasādaṃ
ayaṃ kho so, bhikkhave, nibbedhikapariyāyo dhammapariyāyo'ti
etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya
ehi kho, mārisa, svāgataṃ, mārisa! cirassaṃ kho, mārisa, imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya.
yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā, etādiso vinābhāvo, passa lokassa pariyāyaṃ.
lesakappe pariyāye, parikappe'nudhāvitā, jīvik'atthā upāyena, saṅkaḍḍhanti bahuṃ dhanaṃ.

43975.commentary: (VINa) dvatticchadanassa pariyāyan'ti chadanassa dvattipariyāyaṃ, pariyāyo vuccati parikkhepo, parikkhepadvayaṃ vā parikkhepattayaṃ vā adhiṭṭhātabban'ti attho.

examples.text: mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ appaharite ṭhitena adhiṭṭhātabbaṃ

43979.meaning1: round-about way of saying; indirect mode of expression
43979.commentary: (DNt) pariyāyati kappīyatī'ti pariyāyo, kappiyavāc'ānusārena paṭipatti, tassa kathā'ti pariyāyakathā.

examples.text: vatthasannidhimhi anadhiṭṭhitaṃ avikappitaṃ sannidhi ca hoti, sallekhañ'ca kopeti, ayaṃ pariyāyakathā. nippariyāyato pana ticīvarasantuṭṭhena bhavitabbaṃ, catutthaṃ labhitvā aññassa dātabbaṃ.

43980.meaning1: flees in all directions; goes around

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhayaṃ hoti aṭavisaṅkopo, cakkasamārūḷhā jānapadā pariyāyanti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho asamayo padhānāya.

43981.meaning1: knowing the reason; aware of the purpose; (comm) showing this or that reason for this or that meaning
43981.commentary: (ANa) pariyāyadassāvī'ti tassa tassa atthassa taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ dassento. kāraṇañ'hi idha pariyāyo'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: pariyāyadassāvī kathaṃ kathessāmī'ti paresaṃ dhammo desetabbo.

43982.meaning1: taught figuratively; explained by various means

examples.text: evaṃ pariyāyadesite kho, ānanda, mayā dhamme ye aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanujānissanti na samanumaññissanti na samanumodissanti tesam'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti.

43983.meaning1: fleeing in all directions; going around

examples.text: bhaye kho pana, bhikkhave, sati aṭavisaṅkope cakkasamāruḷhesu jānapadesu pariyāyantesu tattha mātā'pi puttaṃ nappaṭilabhati, putto'pi mātaraṃ nappaṭilabhati.

43984.meaning1: devoted to the practice of eating meals at intervals
43984.commentary: (DNa) pariyāyabhattabhojanan'ti vārabhattabhojanaṃ, ek'āhavārena dvī'havārena satt'āhavārena aḍḍhamāsavārenā'ti evaṃ divasavārena āgatabhattabhojanaṃ.

examples.text: acelako ce'pi, kassapa, hoti, mutt'ācāro, hatth'āpalekhano… iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāyabhattabhojan'ānuyogam'anuyutto viharati.
ek'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti, dvī'hikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti… satt'āhikam'pi āhāraṃ āhārenti. iti evarūpaṃ addhamāsikam'pi pariyāya-bhatta-bhojan'ānuyogam'anuyuttā viharantī'ti.

43985.meaning1: ascetic who eats at intervals; interval faster

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyāyabhattikassa pariyāyabhattikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

43986.meaning1: mere fact of eating at intervals

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ubbhaṭṭhakassa ubbhaṭṭhakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, pariyāyabhattikassa pariyāyabhattikamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi. n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, mantajjhāyakassa mantajjhāyakamattena sāmaññaṃ vadāmi.

43987.grammar: aor of pariyāyaṃ karoti, comp vb, trans (+acc)
43987.meaning1: went out of one's way; made a detour; took a turn

examples.text: etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya. nisīdatu, bhante, bhagavā, idaṃ āsanaṃ paññattan'ti.

43989.meaning1: paraphrase; re-wording; another way of saying

43990.meaning1: makes a detour; goes out of one's way

examples.text: etu kho, bhante, bhagavā. svāgataṃ, bhante, bhagavato. cirassaṃ kho, bhante, bhagavā imaṃ pariyāyam'akāsi, yadidaṃ idh'āgamanāya

43992.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of pariyāya
43992.meaning1: in one way; from a certain point of view; figuratively speaking
43992.commentary: (SNa) pariyāyenā'ti kāraṇena. (ANa) pariyāyenā'ti yasmā tena nāmākāyena paṭhamajjhānaṃ sacchikataṃ, tasmā iminā pariyāyena kāyasakkhi vutto.

examples.text: kassa nu kho, bhante, subhāsitan'ti? sabbesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, subhāsitaṃ pariyāyena, api ca yaṃ mayā sandhāya bhāsitaṃ pārāyane metteyyapañhe

idh'āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc'eva kāmehi… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. yathā yathā ca tadāyatanaṃ tathā tathā naṃ kāyena phusitvā viharati. ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, kāyasakkhī vutto bhagavatā pariyāyena.
takkapariyāhataṃ samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ deseti vīmaṃs'ānucaritaṃ sayaṃpaṭibhānaṃ. yassa ca khv'āssa atthāya dhammo desito so niyyāti takkarassa sammā dukkhakkhayāyā'ti.

43997.meaning1: sought for; searched for; looked for

examples.text: idaṃ me, bhante, vassikasāṭikacīvaraṃ atirekamāse sese gimhāne pariyiṭṭhaṃ atirek'addhamāse sese gimhāne katvā paridahitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ.

43999.commentary: (SNa) pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī'ti pariyuṭṭhān'ākārena abhibhavan'ākārena ṭhito, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti evaṃ taṇhādiṭṭhīhi gilitvā pariniṭṭhapetvā gaṇhanako nāma hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ, ahaṃ rūpaṃ, mama rūpan'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
